name: Flux
review:
Flux is a 15-line sci-fi slot built around rows of stacked wilds and three types of bonus game. Thunderkick lists a numeric volatility value rather than a label, so we don't show one.

It has a 2,562x cap and a 96.2% RTP. A colourful, crystal-themed classic.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Thunderkick doesn't publish a volatility label for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
